decision_reason: ANDiE is a significant NIST-led autonomous neutron diffraction system with peer-reviewed and official NIST evidence of real deployments. This exact repository, however, says its notebooks document one 2021 WAND² run and post-processing; it has no installation/user guide or versioned release, so repository-to-operational-system parity is not yet established. Its embedded NIST notice is an older custom permission grant, not OSI-approved NIST-Software or a clear worldwide dedication. Hold pending eligible rights and evidence this snapshot is a distributable operational implementation rather than a single-run notebook record.

government_provenance.note: NIST's autonomous-methods page names ANDiE and describes its neutron-scattering role; the repository README identifies NIST employees and the exact WAND²/HB-2C run.

public_source.note: Public repository exposes two Jupyter notebooks, one Python helper, and associated data without credentials.

eligible_license.note: README includes the older NIST custom notice: it says foreign copyright may apply and provides conditional, non-exclusive permission; it is not the OSI-approved NIST-Software text or a clear worldwide dedication.

primary_evidence.note: The exact repo describes notebooks and outputs consistent with one 2021 experiment. NIST's paper shows ANDiE was deployed and produced scientific results, but does not establish that this small run-specific notebook repo is the complete distributable system or the source used for that broader result.

agency: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), Materials Measurement Science Division / Data and AI-Driven Materials Science Group, with Oak Ridge National Laboratory instrument collaboration

family_note: ANDiE is a system demonstrated at NIST NCNR and ORNL; this repo's README limits its contents to a particular WAND² run. Do not transfer system-level deployment/use evidence to this exact source snapshot without source parity.
status_note: Official publication (2022) documents real deployments and fivefold measurement-efficiency gains; source snapshot is run-specific and its grant is unresolved.

decision_reason: This repository provides a Bash settings script and spreadsheet for a draft NIST SP 800-179 Rev. 1 checklist for macOS 10.12, but NIST discontinued that draft in 2022, archived the project, and formally deprecated it in favor of SP 800-219. The exact platform is obsolete and no current support/use signal or historically significant standalone tool was established. Reject as superseded legacy supplemental material; its custom license is also not an eligible grant under the strict baseline.

government_provenance.note: NIST's draft SP page links this GitHub repository as supplemental content and identifies the publication authors as NIST personnel.

public_source.note: The public repository provides the Bash script, settings spreadsheet, and README usage instructions.

primary_evidence.note: NIST states SP 800-179 and Draft SP 800-179 Rev. 1 are formally deprecated in favor of SP 800-219; the project itself is archived and only covered macOS 10.10/10.12 legacy guidance.
